title: Status shows as a badge, and each change is its own Part History entry
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. After a status change, read the status badge beside the Part Number label.
  2. Deactivate then later reactivate the part and open its Part History.
  3. Read the type of each entry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The part record shows its current status as a badge beside the Part Number label; every status change is written to Part History as its own entry, and a part deactivated then reactivated keeps both entries, each with its own note.
  • The history entry is typed "Deactivated" for a deactivation and "Activated" for a reactivation.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

  • S10-R15: “Every status change is written to that part's history as its own entry. A part that is deactivated and later reactivated keeps both entries, each with its own note.”
